Profile & Experience
as a video editor.

1,214

Kunal saini

EDITOR

Every project begins with understanding what needs to be done. I take time to understand the requirements, review the available footage and work out the right approach before getting into the edit.

Every editing challenge deserves the right solution– When something doesn't work as expected, I work through the issue, make the necessary adjustments and keep refining the edit until everything comes together as intended.

I believe the smallest details can make a difference. Before delivery, I carefully review the final edit, checking cuts, timing, consistency and overall finishing. I take the time to correct issues and avoid overlooking details that could affect the final result.
